questions.question: What did Ezekiel see in the valley in chapter 37?
options: A valley full of dry bones
A great army drawn up for war
questions.answer: A valley full of dry bones

questions.question: What happened when Ezekiel prophesied to the bones and the breath?
options: They lay there still and entirely silent, and nothing at all happened to them
They were wholly consumed by a great fire that swept across the whole valley
The bones came together, were covered with flesh, and lived as a great army
They crumbled away into fine dust and were scattered abroad by the wind
questions.answer: The bones came together, were covered with flesh, and lived as a great army

questions.question: In the same chapter Ezekiel joined two sticks to symbolize Judah and Israel becoming one nation.
Son of man, can these _____ live? And I answered, 'O Lord GOD, you know.'
These bones are the whole house of Israel; behold, they say, 'Our _____ is lost.'
